description.zh: 查询结果的页码，默认为`1`。

description.en: The dimensions of the metric that you want to query.

description.zh: 结束时间的时间戳，精确到毫秒。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh: 数据片的时间间隔，单位为毫秒，最小值为60000。
description.en: The time interval at which you want to query metric data. Unit: milliseconds. Minimum value: 60000.
The measures of the metric that you want to query.

description.zh: 需要查询的指标，不可自定义输入，请参见下文补充说明。
description.en: The metric that you want to query. You cannot specify a custom metric. For more information, see the "Application monitoring metrics that can be queried" section.

description.zh:
排序标准。取值：

- `ASC`：升序。
- `DESC`：降序。

> 不填则不排序。
description.en:
The order in which measures are sorted. Valid values:

*   `ASC`: ascending order
*   `DESC`: descending order

> If you do not specify the parameter, data is not sorted.

description.zh: 排序依据，可设为任一维度，请参见下文补充说明。
description.en: The dimension for arranging metrics in sequence. For more information, see the supplementary metrics.

description.zh: 此参数已不支持使用。查询结果的每页项目数量。
description.en: This parameter is no longer supported. The number of entries per page.

description.zh: 起始时间的时间戳，精确到毫秒。
description.en: The start of the time range to query. Unit: milliseconds.
